## Layer DAG

`eslint/engine-boundaries.js` (in this package) makes the folder DAG the lint rule, because the engine has no `shared/`, `features/` or `services/` folder for the vendored policy to key on. `ENGINE_DEPS` is the table; a consumer repo's boundaries-policy check lints fixtures against it.

| Layer           | May import                                                   |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| facade          | every layer (`src/index.ts`, `src/kit.ts`)                   |
| `lambda`        | `copilotkit`, `langgraph`, `tools`, `transcription`, `ports` |
| `copilotkit`    | `langgraph`, `tools`, `ports`                                |
| `langgraph`     | `ports`                                                      |
| `tools`         | `ports`                                                      |
| `transcription` | `ports`                                                      |
| `ports`         | —                                                            |

`src/ports.ts` is what the host supplies: the logger (`ChatLogger`, built per module by the host's
`createLogger` factory) and the storage (`ChatStorage`: `ChatHistoryStore`, `UsageStore`, `RunLeaseStore`,
`RunFailureSink`, `dropConnections`). Log through the logger a piece was handed and read or write only
through the stores it was handed, never a module-level one. The package has no product dependency and no
product name in `src` (tests included for imports); a consumer's vendor-readiness check holds both. Product words reach it as options (`app`, `session`), and suites run on the in-memory ports
twin `src/__tests__/helpers/memory-storage.ts`.

An edge added to `ENGINE_DEPS` is an architecture change, not a lint fix. `src/__tests__/` is unchecked on purpose.
